description: Pets is about caring responsibly for an animal over time: keeping a care record, learning about your pet’s needs and the laws that apply, reading about your kind of pet, and showing or training it.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Excerpts confirmed requirements 1–4; requirement 5 offers a choice whose options were not visible and is not outlined yet.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Caring for a pet
requirements.summary: Caring for a pet over several months, with approval before you start.

requirements.title: A report on your pet
requirements.summary: Your pet’s care, feeding and housing, interesting facts, and local laws.

requirements.title: Reading about your pet
requirements.summary: Reading and discussing a book or pamphlet about your kind of pet.

requirements.title: Showing or training
requirements.summary: One option: showing your pet, or training it in tricks or special abilities.
